16 PAN SAUCE RECIPES
There is an endless array of possibilities for pan sauce flavorings.
THE EXECUTION Here are a few basic sauces that complement more than one
type of meat. Each recipe serves four.
Here’s how to make a pan sauce step by step.
RED WINE & BALSAMIC SAUCE WITH ROSEMARY FOR BEEF AND PORK
1 large shallot, minced (about 4 tablespoons)
1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar
1⁄ 2 cup red wine
3⁄ 4 cup canned low-sodium chicken broth
1 teaspoon minced fresh rosemary leaves
3 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cut into 3 pieces
Salt and ground black pepper

vermouth or Marsala) should be reduced slowly, separately,
and with a few aromatic vegetables and herbs. To use a wine
reduction, deglaze the pan used to cook the meat with broth
only, then add the reduced wine at the end of cooking, with
the butter. This method takes more time and effort but yields
a superior sauce because the flavor compounds present in the
raw wine are better preserved than when the wine is allowed to
simmer rapidly. Two tablespoons of wine reduction is equivalent
to 1⁄ 2 to 3⁄ 4 cup raw wine.
